name: Voltalia SA
summary: Voltalia SA engages in the production of electricity from renewable energy sources. It operates in two segments, Energy Sales and Services. The company develops, constructs, operates, and maintains wind, solar, hydro, and biomass power plants. It also develops and sells projects, and procures equipment for solar power plants, as well as provides maintenance service. As of December 31, 2019, the company had an installed capacity of 0.7 GW, and 0.4 GW under construction, as well as operated 0.5 GW for third parties. It operates in France, Italy, Spain, the United Kingdom, rest of Europe, Brazil, Mexico, Colombia, Egypt, Kenya, Morocco, and Asia. The company was founded in 2005 and is headquartered in Paris, France. Voltalia SA is a subsidiary of Voltalia Investissement SA.
